mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'PASS' THEN 1 END) AS passCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'FAIL' THEN 1 END) AS failCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 END) AS errorCount FROM baseline_result WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}

SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'middleware' THEN 'Middleware' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'database' THEN 'Database' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'webapp' THEN 'WebApp' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'website' THEN 'Website' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'bigdata' THEN 'BigData' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'service' THEN 'Service' ELSE 'Unknown' END AS name, COUNT(1) AS count FROM host_asset_inventory WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (deleted = 0 OR deleted IS NULL) GROUP BY CASE WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'middleware' THEN 'Middleware' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'database' THEN 'Database' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'webapp' THEN 'WebApp' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'website' THEN 'Website' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'bigdata' THEN 'BigData' WHEN LOWER(COALESCE(category, 'unknown')) = 'service' THEN 'Service' ELSE 'Unknown' END ORDER BY count DESC, name ASC

SELECT h.id AS hostId, COALESCE(NULLIF(h.hostname, ''), NULLIF(h.ipv4, ''), h.mac_address, CONCAT('Host#', h.id)) AS hostName, COALESCE(NULLIF(h.ipv4, ''), h.mac_address) AS ipv4, COALESCE(ai.assetCount, 0) AS assetCount, COALESCE(br.passCount, 0) AS baselinePassCount, COALESCE(br.failCount, 0) AS baselineFailCount, COALESCE(br.errorCount, 0) AS baselineErrorCount, COALESCE(vr.criticalCount, 0) AS criticalVulnCount, COALESCE(vr.highCount, 0) AS highVulnCount, COALESCE(vr.mediumCount, 0) AS mediumVulnCount, COALESCE(vr.lowCount, 0) AS lowVulnCount, COALESCE(pr.patchRiskCount, 0) AS patchRiskCount, COALESCE(sa.alertCount, 0) AS alertCount, GREATEST( COALESCE(br.latestTime, '1970-01-01 00:00:00'), COALESCE(vr.latestTime, '1970-01-01 00:00:00'), COALESCE(pr.latestTime, '1970-01-01 00:00:00'), COALESCE(sa.latestTime, '1970-01-01 00:00:00'), COALESCE(h.updated_at, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') ) AS latestActivityTime FROM hosts h LEFT JOIN ( SELECT host_id, COUNT(1) AS assetCount FROM host_asset_inventory WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND (deleted = 0 OR deleted IS NULL) GROUP BY host_id ) ai ON ai.host_id = h.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT host_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'PASS' THEN 1 END) AS passCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'FAIL' THEN 1 END) AS failCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'ERROR' THEN 1 END) AS errorCount, MAX(scan_time) AS latestTime FROM baseline_result WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} GROUP BY host_id ) br ON br.host_id = h.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT host_id, COUNT(CASE WHEN LOWER(severity) = 'critical' THEN 1 END) AS criticalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN LOWER(severity) = 'high' THEN 1 END) AS highCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN LOWER(severity) = 'medium' THEN 1 END) AS mediumCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN LOWER(severity) = 'low' THEN 1 END) AS lowCount, MAX(COALESCE(updated_at, created_at)) AS latestTime FROM host_vuln_result WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 1 AND rule_id IS NOT NULL AND rule_id > 0 GROUP BY host_id ) vr ON vr.host_id = h.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT host_id, COUNT(1) AS patchRiskCount, MAX(scan_time) AS latestTime FROM host_patch_risk WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'open' GROUP BY host_id ) pr ON pr.host_id = h.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT host_id, COUNT(1) AS alertCount, MAX(event_time) AS latestTime FROM security_alerts WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status IN ('new', 'acked') GROUP BY host_id ) sa ON sa.host_id = h.id WHERE h.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY latestActivityTime DESC, h.id ASC

SELECT MAX(activity_time) FROM ( SELECT MAX(scan_time) AS activity_time FROM baseline_result WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} UNION ALL SELECT MAX(COALESCE(updated_at, created_at)) AS activity_time FROM host_vuln_result WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND rule_id IS NOT NULL AND rule_id > 0 UNION ALL SELECT MAX(scan_time) AS activity_time FROM host_patch_risk WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} UNION ALL SELECT MAX(event_time) AS activity_time FROM security_alerts WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ) t

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(scan_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS label, COUNT(1) AS count FROM baseline_result WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND scan_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(scan_time) >= #{startDate} AND status IN ('FAIL', 'ERROR') GROUP BY DATE(scan_time) ORDER BY DATE(scan_time) ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') AS label, COUNT(1) AS count FROM host_vuln_result WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND created_at IS NOT NULL AND DATE(created_at) >= #{startDate} AND status = 1 AND rule_id IS NOT NULL AND rule_id > 0 GROUP BY DATE(created_at) ORDER BY DATE(created_at) ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(scan_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS label, COUNT(1) AS count FROM host_patch_risk WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND scan_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(scan_time) >= #{startDate} AND status = 'open' GROUP BY DATE(scan_time) ORDER BY DATE(scan_time) ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(event_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS label, COUNT(1) AS count FROM security_alerts WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND event_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE(event_time) >= #{startDate} AND status IN ('new', 'acked') GROUP BY DATE(event_time) ORDER BY DATE(event_time) ASC
